name: fxi-studio
description: Connect your FXI Studio account to direct cinematic stills and video clips from a conversation.

interface.longDescription: Connect your FXI Studio account to direct cinematic stills and video clips from a conversation. Ask for a shot and FXI picks a suitable model for the job, shows the result inline and saves every take to your FXI library. Frame chaining turns 2 to 8 scene descriptions into clips where each clip starts on the last frame of the one before, so motion carries across shots. Compose a scene from your saved characters, check your credits and look up past generations at any time. Sign in with your FXI Studio account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Direct two shots into one continuous scene
Generate a fast draft still, then upgrade to high quality
Create a short vertical scene, 9:16, chaining two shots

publication.release_notes: v1.1.0: adds 3 starter prompts and 3 workflow skills (direct-a-film, pick-the-right-model, use-fxi-for-media). About text, capabilities, links, and MCP tools are unchanged from the published v1.0.0 metadata.
